newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips targets positive NLG 1 bn cash flow.
newsitem.headline: Philips targets positive NLG 1 bn cash flow.

text.p: Philips Electronics chairman Cor Boonstra on Thursday reiterated the company's commitment to achieving sustainable double-digit growth in income from operations and a substantial positive cash flow.
"Specifically, our primary commitment is to deliver a positive cash flow of over one billion guilders in 1997," Boonstra said in his first message to shareholders.
Philips reported earlier that cash flow before financing activities amounted to a deficit of 1.86 billion guilders in 1996. This compares to a cash outflow of 1.66 billion guilders in 1995.
It said that phasing out its securitization programme during 1996 had reduced cash flow by 860 million guilders.
Boonstra further reiterated the company's longer-term goal of a 24 percent return on net operating capital.
Philips on Thursday reported a net loss of 590 million guilders over the full-1996 year, compared with a year-earlier net profit of 2.52 billion guilders.
